blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House Prosecution panel said Thursday that it would drop impeachment articles IV, II, and I, referring to Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged grave threats and confidential funds. This decision leaves the prosecution with only Article II, Duterte’s supposed unexplained wealth, for its formal offer of exhibits.
